run_vqvae_code_extraction: run the script to extract VQVAE codes from audio files in a directory using a checkpoint model
run_inference_on_audio: run inference on a single audio file to extract VQVAE codes using the encoder and vector quantizer
run_multi_gpu_extraction: run multi-GPU VQVAE code extraction across audio files using a process pool with GPU assignment
review_init_worker: review the init_worker function that loads the CodeGenerator checkpoint and initializes the encoder and VQ modules
review_inference_function: review the inference function that reads audio, encodes it, and extracts VQVAE codes as comma-separated values
